response.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS mean_signed FROM f) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed) AS avg_of_signed_avgs, AVG(f.avg_bal) AS avg_of_balance_avgs, AVG(f.avg_signed - m.mean_signed) AS avg_excess FROM f CROSS JOIN m WHERE f.avg_signed > m.mean_signed

assumptions.assumption: The average balance per frequency is taken over all transactions linked to an account, including VYBER and other types that are left out of the signed amount average.
Transactions of type other than PRIJEM or VYDAJ (such as VYBER) are excluded from the signed amount average only. They are NULL in the CASE expression, so AVG ignores them.
The simple mean is the unweighted mean of the per-frequency signed averages, not weighted by transaction count.

alternatives.interpretation: The average balance is computed only over the transactions that count in the signed average (PRIJEM and VYDAJ), so both averages use the same rows.
alternatives.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') GROUP BY a.frequency), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS mean_signed FROM f) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed) AS avg_of_signed_avgs, AVG(f.avg_bal) AS avg_of_balance_avgs, AVG(f.avg_signed - m.mean_signed) AS avg_excess FROM f CROSS JOIN m WHERE f.avg_signed > m.mean_signed
